question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no.5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Devices**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence "***Parents, in general, say that they have always tried to keep their children away from (5) ______ like mobile phones and tablets, but the current Covid-19 situation has forced the children into online learning, and they spend long hours in front of screens" ***expresses us about the efforts of parents to keep their children away from smart devices such as mobile phones and tablets.
 
• It is clear from the usage of **mobile phones and tablets **which are smart **devices **that are used by children for online learning.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is '**devices**'
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**

So the complete passage is- __*According to a news report, schools are setting up adequate facilities and taking (1) steps to restart learning on campus hoping to reopen schools later, if not sooner. (2) while schools are preparing themselves to restart, most parents are still not sure of sending their (3) children to school. Parents of primary school children are particularly concerned about their children's (4) exposure to health risks. Parents, in general, say that they have always tried to keep their children away from (5) devices like mobile phones and tablets, but the current Covid-19 situation has forced the children into online learning, and they spend long hours in front of screens.*
